scripts.preinstall: node -e "const v=process.versions.node; const major=Number(v.split('.')[0]); if(major!==22){console.error('Node ' + v + ' is not allowed. Use Node 22.x only.'); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -c blue,magenta -n backend,web "pnpm --dir backend dev" "/bin/sh -c 'until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3001/health >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; pnpm --dir apps/web dev'"
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently -c blue,magenta,green -n backend,web,tunnel "pnpm --dir backend dev" "/bin/sh -c 'until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3001/health >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; pnpm --dir apps/web dev'" "/bin/sh -c 'until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3001/health >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; pnpm --dir backend exec tsx ../scripts/dev/sync-ngrok.ts'"
scripts.dev:clean: kill -9 $(lsof -ti :3001) $(lsof -ti :5173) 2>/dev/null || true; pkill ngrok 2>/dev/null || true; pnpm dev:tunnel
scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/shared build && pnpm --dir packages/db build && pnpm --filter @starway/ai run build && pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.clean: pnpm --dir packages/shared clean && pnpm --dir packages/db clean && pnpm --dir packages/ai clean && pnpm --dir backend clean && pnpm --dir apps/web clean
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/shared typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/db typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/ai typecheck && pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
